# `morphir package restore`

- **Usage:** `morphir package restore <FLAGS>`

Restore an exact locked Library graph using fresh signed metadata

## Flags
- **`--policy <FILE>`** — Explicit trusted-host policy file
- **`--lock <FILE>`** — Full package lock; replay never rewrites it
- **`--registry <DIR>`** — Caller-controlled local registry; the MVP supports one registry per graph
- **`--state <DIR>`** — Existing explicitly initialized trust-state directory
- **`--output <DIR>`** — Destination for the complete verified Library graph
- **`--assurance <ASSURANCE>`** — Explicitly accept caller-controlled local roots; hardened mode is unsupported

  **Choices:** `portable`
- **`--json`** — Output the restore result as JSON
